packageRules.description: Batch all minor + patch updates (non-major) into a single weekly PR
Automerge patch-level devDependency bumps when CI passes. Covers test tooling, linters, type stubs, and bundler plugins — low-risk categories unlikely to introduce runtime regressions.
Major updates are always separate, clearly labeled, and require human review

React and Next.js major versions require explicit human approval and a migration-notes issue. These changes can involve breaking API surface, build config changes, or peer dependency shifts across the whole app.
prBodyNotes: 1. Open a migration-notes issue using the `major-dependency-migration` template.
2. Validate SSR/streaming changes, App Router behavior, and React 19+ API surface.
3. Run the full test suite and E2E golden paths locally.

packageRules.description: Internal @delegolabs/* packages are pinned to released tags. Bumps must be explicit PRs — they imply SDK/types/ui contract changes and need a changelog review.
prBodyNotes: 📦 **Internal package bump**. Review the package CHANGELOG before merging.
Ensure no breaking API surface changes affect consuming features.

packageRules.description: Security vulnerability alerts bypass grouping and get individual PRs immediately, regardless of the normal weekly schedule.
prBodyNotes: 🔒 **Security advisory fix**. This PR was opened out of band due to a vulnerability alert.
Review the advisory and confirm the fix resolves the CVE before merging.
